meta.name: game-build
meta.description: Build the game for its approved target runtime. Compress GAME_DESIGN and ART_DIRECTION into a minimal BUILD_BRIEF, hand it to the current coding agent or another strong model to implement a fully playable build, and iterate against real runs and captured evidence. Use for implement the approved game design, build the game prototype, turn this design into a running game. 游戏构建执行。把批准后的 GAME_DESIGN 与 ART_DIRECTION 压缩成最小 BUILD_BRIEF，交给当前编码智能体或其他强模型，在选定的目标运行环境中实现可完整游玩的版本，并通过真实运行和证据迭代。用于把批准的游戏方案实现成可运行游戏。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把游戏设计变成能跑起来的完整版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果已有批准的游戏设计,想快速产出可运行的原型
copy.tagline_en: Turn approved game designs into playable builds
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have an approved game design and want to quickly produce a playable prototype

howto.what: 装上后,它会先读已批准的游戏设计与美术方向,压缩成一份构建说明,再交给编码智能体或其他模型实现成可完整玩的原型,并用真实运行和截图证据反复修错。产出构建说明、游戏文件和验证报告。
howto.when: 当你提出“实现已批准的游戏设计”“构建游戏原型”“把这个设计做成可运行游戏”等要求,且已有 GAME_DESIGN.md 与 ART_DIRECTION.md 时触发。

say.text: 请构建已批准的游戏设计,并在完成后跑 QA 验证。
say.note: 验证日志与结果写入 qa 目录。

say.text: 把这个设计做成可运行游戏,按目标平台打包。

howto.what_en: Claude turns an approved game design into a playable build: it compresses design docs into a BUILD_BRIEF, has a coding model implement it, then fixes issues by running the game and checking recorded evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to implement the approved game design, build the game prototype, or turn the design into a running game, and when GAME_DESIGN.md and ART_DIRECTION.md already exist.

say_en.text: Turn this design into a playable prototype per the approved design docs.
say_en.note: Generates a BUILD_BRIEF and starts iterating.

say_en.text: Implement the approved design, then run the verification command.
say_en.note: Saves the verification log under qa/evidence/.

say_en.text: Make this design a runnable game per PRODUCT_BRIEF.
say_en.note: Builds for the target runtime and records evidence.
